data.desc: Callan JMB, Inc. (NASDAQ: CJMB) is a diversified healthcare logistics, preparedness, and manufacturing, and critical infrastructure company serving healthcare organizations, government agencies, and commercial customers. The Company provides fulfillment, warehousing, cold-chain logistics, monitoring, regulatory compliance, specialty packaging, pharmaceutical support services, and emergency preparedness solutions designed to strengthen supply chains and protect critical products. Through strategic partnerships, acquisitions, and organic growth initiatives, Calen JMB is building a platform spanning healthcare and pharmaceutical logistics, domestic pharmaceutical manufacturing, critical electrical infrastructure, specialty industrial manufacturing, preparedness services, and energy development.
